answer: Seeded Quota Lottery. Each epoch, a public randomness beacon seeds a lottery that assigns every agent a fixed number of action slots; an attacker cannot forge slot counts in advance because the seed appears only at the epoch's dawn. To occupy N slots, the attacker must control N independently registered keys, and registration requires a per-key delay plus a frozen deposit that a glacier-slow audit releases only after consistent participation. Sybil cost thus scales linearly with real keys and time, not with cheap claims.
